homeAbout.titleLight: The future is not a place we arrive at.
homeAbout.description: WKX is a people-powered foundation for the beautifully stubborn. We find local leaders with big ideas, then give them the trust, tools and time to make those ideas real. Together, we work towards stronger communities, better opportunities and lasting change.

image.alt: WKX Foundation community members participating in a local development initiative
image.caption: Real change begins when communities lead their own future.

homePrograms.description: We work alongside communities to create lasting opportunities through clean water, women's empowerment and accessible education.

programs.title: The Water Table
programs.description: Building access to clean, safe water through community-led solutions that support healthier everyday lives.
programs.imageAlt: Community members accessing clean drinking water from a shared water point.

programs.title: Her Next Chapter
programs.description: Supporting women with opportunities, practical skills and resources to build independent and sustainable livelihoods.
programs.imageAlt: Women participating together in a community empowerment initiative.

programs.title: Open Classroom
programs.description: Creating welcoming learning opportunities where children can discover their potential and build brighter futures.
programs.imageAlt: Children participating in a community education activity.

homeCause.description: Every donation supports a specific project. Choose a cause close to your heart and discover how your contribution can make a difference.

causes.title: School for every child
causes.description: Books, uniforms and nutritious meals help children in rural communities stay in school and build brighter futures.
causes.imageAlt: Children reading and learning together in a classroom
causes.fundsUse: Your donation helps provide school supplies, learning materials, uniforms and nutritious meals.

causes.title: Clean water for villages
causes.description: Community water pumps and filtration systems bring safe drinking water closer to families who need it.
causes.imageAlt: Community members collecting clean water from a water pump
causes.fundsUse: Your donation supports water infrastructure, filtration systems and community-led maintenance.

causes.title: Health camps on wheels
causes.description: Mobile health services bring medical check-ups, essential medicines and healthcare professionals to underserved communities.
causes.imageAlt: A healthcare worker providing medical assistance to a community member
causes.fundsUse: Your donation helps support medical supplies, essential medicines and mobile healthcare visits.

testimonials.quote: My daughter used to miss school to fetch water. Now she is first in her class and wants to become a teacher.
testimonials.name: Sunita Devi

testimonials.quote: I have given to many charities, but this is the first one that sends me photos and receipts showing exactly where my money went.
testimonials.name: Rohan Mehta

testimonials.quote: The mobile clinic comes every Thursday. For the first time, our elders get check-ups without travelling two hours to town.
testimonials.name: Dr. Anita Rao

testimonials.quote: Volunteering with the team showed me how much a small group can do when every rupee and every hour is used well.
testimonials.name: Imran Sheikh
